name: Storm watch
summary: Storms in NASA IMERG rain data, tracked over 24 hours. Click a storm or press N to hear it: each region plays its own instrument, bigger storms louder.
author: itay
description: Follow individual storms through 48 half-hourly IMERG frames, tracked offline with computer vision (OpenCV optical flow and watershed). Click a storm, or press N and P on the map, to hear it (hovering only names it): each region plays its own instrument, panned by longitude, and bigger storms are louder (under More, size or latitude can drive pitch or volume instead). Enter follows a storm, and when storms merge and split the whole family stays marked; Page Up and Page Down step through time. The full tracking studio with tuning sliders is linked from the panel. From itay's clustering branch.
